To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a susceptibility gene for alv. lung tumors in the C57BL/6 strain of mice, located between Hsp70 and G7, influences the alveolar tumor load but not the papillary tumor load.
The alveolar lung tumour load is influenced by a susceptibility gene within the Hsp 70.3-G-7 interval.
the alveoloar lung tumor load in the mouse is significantly influenced by a gene located within the C4-G7 interval of the H2 complex.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the elucidation of the molecular basis of the lung tumor susceptibility gene within the H2 locus.
the genetic basis of susceptibility to alveolar lung tumorigenesis in the mouse.
the identification of susceptibility loci for alveolar tumors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the H2 region contains multiple genes which influence the lung tumor susceptibility of the mouse.
the Hsp70 gene family, including the Hsp70 genes, is involved in the susceptibility to alveolar lung tumorigenesis in the mouse, but not to papillary lung tumorigenosis.
the genetic basis for alveolar tumor susceptibility is complex and includes at least three genes, one in the H-2 complex, one in the Gm region, and a third gene in the Hsp70-3-G7 region.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the alveolus is the target of a carcinogenic event and that the papillary tumor is the target of an anti-carcinogenic event.
the H-2 region contains at least two genes, H2-Db and the Hsp70 gene, which influence the susceptibility to alveolar lung tumorigenesis.

the H2 complex contains at least two distinct genes that influence susceptibility to alveolar lung cancer, a major histocompatibility locus (H2) and a non-major histocompatibility locus, Hsp70.1, located within the H2D region.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the genetic background influences the susceptibility of mice to lung tumors and that a gene located within the region between HSP70.3 and H2D influences the susceptibility to alveolar lung adenomas in mice.
the genetic background has a strong impact on the development of alveolar tumors in the mouse.
the genetic background of mice influences the development of tumors in response to carcinogen exposure.
